title: How to Issue and Scan Barcoded Inpatient Attender Passes
content:
ARTICLE: How to Issue and Scan Barcoded Inpatient Attender Passes (KA-029)
SYSTEM: Security Terminal
DEPARTMENT: Front Office and Registration
VERSION: 1.3
OVERVIEW: This comprehensive operating guide details how hospital personnel should interact with the Security Terminal module to execute how to issue and scan barcoded inpatient attender passes safely and reliably.
STEPS:
Step 1: Open the Security Terminal client terminal on any networked SMCH workstation and log in with role credentials.
Step 2: Enter the patient's unique UHID or Case Number to load active records.
Step 3: Access the designated submenu corresponding to How to Issue and Scan Barcoded Inpatient Attender Passes and verify current patient status.
Step 4: Input all required clinical or administrative parameters, ensuring mandatory fields are validated.
Step 5: Verify preview confirmation modal and click 'Submit' to persist changes to the database.
Step 6: Print barcode, acknowledgement chit, or receipt as required by hospital compliance.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Connection timeout: Verify LAN cable connection or contact IT Helpdesk.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Permission Denied: Ensure user account has the assigned role in staff master permissions.
Contact Front Office and Registration coordinator or IT Operations Support at Extension 1033 (Email: it@smch.in).
